This is the first permanent-deletion approach.

Open [the deletion prototype](http://maker:4001/archive-action.html?mode=delete-archived), archive **Planning useful customer interviews**, open **Archived · 1**, and click **Delete permanently**—then stop at the confirmation message. Please tell me how that safeguard feels.

I assumed permanent deletion is available only after a bookmark has been archived, remains a separate red action from Restore, and always requires confirmation that names the bookmark and says it cannot be undone. We’ll compare this with one other working approach before choosing.
